openingMessage: You're going to pay a price for everything you do and everything you don't do.
openingWhy: The bleed-down check costs ten minutes. Skipping it costs whatever the well decides to charge — and the field sets brutal prices. In Odessa it was two lives for one monitor left in the truck. There's no free option. Just the small bill now, or the one nobody can pay.
leadershipThought: Situational awareness is not a skill. It's a habit. You build it before you need it. The drive to location is the first job of the day — and the most dangerous thing most of us will do all week.
